applies_why: The judge text treats the cited wording and application as answered and enters no verse as an unanswered witness, so K-G4's counting requirement is not triggered.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: The judge says the relevant material was answered, and K-G4 expressly excludes answered verses from being counted.
